title: Prospector Lab: Prompt Fragility Tracker & Supplier Response Index
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a repeatable framework that measures how small, realistic prompt perturbations change model outputs across providers and model variants (open & closed). Produce two public-facing artifacts for internal stakeholders: (1) a Prompt Fragility Score that quantifies sensitivity per model/route/use-case, and (2) a Supplier Response Index that records vendor operational responsiveness and mitigation quality when fragility issues are reported.
motivation: Sales and platform teams are seeing customers worry about regressions when switching model variants or applying prompt engineering at scale. We need objective signals to prioritize model onboarding, fallback choices, and quantization trade-offs. This also helps procurement and SREs choose resilient default models for Dedicated/Private customers.
success_metrics: 1) Fragility Score computed for 40+ models across 6 benchmark prompt families. 2) Supplier Response Index scored for top-6 vendors using a defined response rubric. 3) Dashboard surfaced in Console with historical trends and weekly alerts. 4) Two customer-facing one-pagers for Sales/SEs explaining tradeoffs.
methodology:
- Collect representative prompt families: RAG system prompts, instruction-following, few-shot summarization, form-filling templates, and short Q/A.
- Generate perturbations per family: punctuation/noise, paraphrase, order-swaps, token truncation, and context-drop.
- Run synthetic workloads across model variants and measure: semantic divergence (ROUGE/Embedding cosine), instruction-following failure modes, hallucination rate proxies, and latency/cost delta.
- Compute Fragility Score: weighted combination of semantic drift, task-failure frequency, and sensitivity to truncation.
- Supplier Response Index: record time-to-ack, mitigation quality (hotfix/rollout/patch), documentation updates, and back-compat notes after a scripted report to vendor support.
- Tie to Console telemetry: ingestion via nightly batch jobs and streaming canary probes for high-impact routes.
deliverables: 1) Fragility scoring pipeline (notebook + jobs) in GitHub. 2) Console dashboard spec and demo widgets. 3) Supplier Response Index handbook and vendor playbook. 4) Two one-page sales assets and an internal runbook for incident-driven vendor probes.
acceptance_criteria:
- End-to-end pipeline processes 500 perturbed prompts across a model in <2 hours on dedicated infra.
- Fragility Score aligns with manual QA on 10 spot-check prompts (>=80% agreement).
- Dashboard shows last 90 days trend and emits alert when Fragility Score increases >15% week-over-week for a production model.
- Supplier Response Index entries for at least 4 vendors completed and validated by Solutions Engineering.

risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Semantic divergence metrics may not correlate with human-perceived regression. Mitigation: run human-in-the-loop spot checks and tune weights.
Risk: Vendor cooperation for Response Index may be limited. Mitigation: use public changelogs, support ticket timelines, and proxy interactions via partner accounts.
Risk: High compute cost to run large battery nightly. Mitigation: sample stratified subsets and move heavy runs to weekly cadence for low-impact models.
open_questions: Which exact models should be in the "initial 40+" list (ask Research for 2026 quarter target)?
Do we expose raw prompt perturbations to customers in the Console or only aggregate scores?
Should Supplier Response Index be public to customers or internal-only?
